description: Modebase connects your real wardrobe to ChatGPT so you can find pieces, preview outfits, plan what to wear, and build capsules from clothes you own. Add garments through a phone capture link or supplied photo, save outfits and style preferences, log wears, and review wardrobe usage. Create private edits or explicitly requested shareable lookbooks, and retrieve garment images for presentations.

defaultPrompt: Create an outfit for work tomorrow using my wardrobe
Create a capsule wardrobe for a three-day trip
Show me what I own in my wardrobe that I could resell
